title: Harvesting plan and District Committee
rule: Harvesting needs an approved Harvesting Plan. A District Forest Produce Harvesting Committee decides applications for certificates of allocation.
points: The plan covers production national, local authority, village and community reserves, and forests on general and village land except Wildlife Management Areas.
No application is considered without proof of an approved plan.

Committee members: District Commissioner (chair), District Land and Natural Resources Officer, District Forest Officer, chairman of the responsible village, Village Executive Officer, District Executive Director. The District Forest Officer is Secretary.
It meets at least once a year. The quorum is half the members including the chair.
A certificate of allocation is non-transferable.
checks: Approved Harvesting Plan for the area
src: GN 417 pp. 6 to 7, as amended in 2023
